Sulfur dioxide is converted to sulfur trioxide in the Contact process.
The conditions used are 450°C and 200kPa with a vanadium(V) oxide catalyst.
Which row describes and explains the effect of changing conditions on the rate of reaction?
change in conditions
effect on rate
explanation
A
no catalyst
lower
the activation energy is higher
B
higher pressure
higher
the particles have more kinetic energy
C
lower temperature
lower
the particles collide more frequently
D
lower pressure
higher
there are more particles per unit volume
